prompt:
Edit paint_mask_guide.png using design_reference.png as material/detail reference and icon_x8.png as copper colour reference (magenta is background, never paint magenta). Output ONE transparent PNG, 1536x2048 or nearest 3:4 size. Preserve the exact guide sheet: 3 columns by FOUR rows of equal square cells. Rows 1-2 and rows 3-4 contain the same five views FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty. The unusual orientations shown in the guide are authoritative; do not reinterpret the view names. Each object must remain in exactly the same position, size, outline and orientation as the grey guide. Paint grey objects only; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign them.

Rows 1-2 PAINT: unlit base colour of warm polished copper plate armour: domed breastplate with vertical centre ridge, layered rounded copper shoulder plates, ribbed segmented copper arm plates, long skirt of vertical copper plate strips on riveted bands; small dark rivets, soft pale copper colour variation, no other colours. Follow the approved design reference details scaled to each view. Unlit base colour only: no lighting, cast shadows, ambient occlusion, hot highlights or reflections. Copper colour must remain readable on internal surfaces without baked dark occlusion.

Rows 3-4 MATERIAL MASK: the same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours only, no shading, texture, outlines or antialiased colour blends inside. Pure red #FF0000 for EVERY metal part including copper and rivets. Pure green #00FF00 for leather/fur only if present. Pure blue #0000FF for cloth/hair only if present. Pure black #000000 for gemstone/crystal/glass/pearl/enamel/liquid only if present. This item is copper plate armour, so the entire lower five silhouettes should be flat pure red. Every pixel of each silhouette gets exactly one material colour. Nothing outside silhouettes.

Keep every gap and opening exactly as in guide and fully transparent. Empty cells column 3 row 2 and column 3 row 4 stay empty and transparent. No glow halo, sparkles, aura, ground, outlines or text. Maintain exact silhouette registration between upper painted five and lower mask five.
CRITICAL correction: lower material masks must have surgically clean alpha silhouettes exactly matching the original grey guide. No scattered pixels, spray, noise, red haze or red pixels anywhere outside those silhouettes. All holes in original guide remain fully transparent, especially neck holes. Flat red masks have no dark red interior shapes or shading. Copy original guide alpha boundaries faithfully. Upper paint must be diffuse copper base colour, not shiny illuminated render.
